messages:
Dana Rivera: Hey team — heads up: a reporter from TechWire just posted a short preview citing our benchmark numbers before embargo. Link: https://techwire.example/preview (they quoted a line from the draft).
Mira Patel: Ack. Did they get the doc or a leak?
Evan Park: I pinged the reporter. Their tweet says they received a preview email from an external vendor. I asked for clarification and politely requested removal until 11:00 PT.
Tom Brooks: Mirror social hold. Do not post any related content until we confirm removal.
Dana Rivera: Social hold acknowledged. @press-bot can you pause scheduled posts for the 11:00 publish?
press-bot: Action received: pausing scheduled jobs matching tags [benchmarks, launch]. Interrupted jobs: 3. Status=paused.
Mira Patel: Legal: Suggest we issue a short, neutral DM to the reporter asking for correction and offering the full methodology after publish. Avoid accusing. Draft: "Appreciate the interest — could you please hold on publishing detailed benchmark numbers until 11:00 PT? We can provide full methodology then."
Dana Rivera: Good. Evan — send that now. Also prepare a 1-paragraph public statement in case outlets repost. Keep it factual.
Evan Park: Sent the DM and follow-up email. Reporter replied: "We're running a piece but happy to delay a full story. Can we quote the headline?" Asking now.
Tom Brooks: If they insist on the headline, use the neutral framing: "Redwood Inference publishes new internal benchmark highlighting latency and cost improvements; full report available at 11 PT." No comparative claims.
Mira Patel: Also flag customer comms — one named customer mentioned in the case study prefers no early mention. We should coordinate with Solutions to notify them.
Dana Rivera: I messaged Jordan from Solutions to confirm no customer quotes go out early. Jordan said they'll hold.
press-bot: Alert: embargo window originally 11:00 PT. Current time 09:42 PT. Escalation rule: if public pickup before 10:30 PT, notify exec-comm.
Evan Park: Reporter updated: they'll pull the preview down and hold until our publish. They asked for a short embargo-friendly quote.
Tom Brooks: OK provide a soft quote: "We're excited to share benchmark results tomorrow that demonstrate meaningful reductions in latency and cost on typical LLM workloads." Keep it high-level.
Mira Patel: Draft quote clear. No absolute numbers, no competitor mentions. Post it in PR folder.
Dana Rivera: Posting now: https://drive.redwood/pr/bench-quote-v1 — tagging Tom for sign-off.
Tom Brooks: Signed. Good to send.
press-bot: Job update: paused jobs remain paused. Resume scheduled tasks only after manual confirmation.
Dana Rivera: Team note: keep this thread for press updates only. If anything goes live unexpectedly, ping @channel + call Mira.
Evan Park: Will monitor for 2 hours. I'll also collect screenshots if any outlets republish.
Mira Patel: Thanks. After publish we'll send a short note to partner vendors reminding about embargo windows. Also adding a short checklist to the blog: "If you're a partner who received preview assets, please hold until 11 PT."
Dana Rivera: Solid. Final: planned publish now moved to 11:00 PT (was 10:00). I updated calendar invites and the publish job to that time.
press-bot: Publish job rescheduled: job-id=pb-2025-1115-11 -> new-time=11:00 PT. Status=scheduled.
